text:
samir: @channel Hey team — Acme (enterprise) wants a 2-week POC. They need hosted API keys + a short-lived Dedicated pool test and optional Private/VPC plan if the security team approves. Can we provision a billing project with free credits and a spend cap, then hand over credentials?

lina: @samir yep — what dollar amount for free credits and what's the daily cap we should enforce? also need the company billing contact and PO number (if any). :clipboard:

samir: let's offer $5,000 in POC credits and a $200/day soft cap. contact is emma@acme.com, no PO for initial trial. start date target Mon next week.

keith: for Dedicated — quick Q: expected steady QPS / tokens per request? ephemeral pool spin-up is fine for POC but we need to size GPUs. if they want to test long sequences or batching we'll need a bigger flavor.

emma (via email paste by samir): "we expect ~15 qps, avg 800 tokens per session"

keith: OK that maps to ~1 A10/1x with autoscale for a 2-week run. We can allocate a dev-dedicated pool with autoscale min=0, max=2. Note that Dedicated requires attaching the pool to their billing project to track spend.

lina: I'm going to create a temp billing project and attach credits + daily cap. Internal CLI I will run:```
# internal only
rwctl billing projects create --org acme --id poc-acme-8821 --credits 5000 --daily-cap 200 --owner emma@acme.com
```
This will create PROJECT ID: poc-acme-8821 and a billing org entry. I'll also enable hosted API product and Dedicated trial SKU.

natalie: deploy-bot: billing project poc-acme-8821 created (id: poc-acme-8821). Credentials pending. :white_check_mark:

natalie: For Hosted API keys: I'll create a scoped API key with only text-generation + embeddings for the POC and store it in our vault. Access will be granted to the Okta group acme-poc. For Dedicated pool access we provide a service account key with role: inference.poolTester.

keith: Private/VPC note: if they request Private, we need their VPC CIDR, a contact for peering, and completed security questionnaire. Peering requires opening the following ports and routes; I'll send the template.

lina: security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/poc-questionnaire v2 — fill and send back. If they prefer no Private, we can run POC hosted + dedicated pool without peering.

samir: @lina @keith can you confirm ETA to have keys + pool + billing project ready? Customer asked for everything by Friday EOD.

keith: I'll have the Dedicated pool stubbed and IAM role ready by Thu. Need natalie to release the service account.

natalie: Vault entry created for hosted API key and service account pending rotation step. I'll grant access to acme-poc Okta group and email emma with retrieval steps. ETA Thu morning.

lina: Billing project created and credits attached. Daily cap enforced; I've documented the spend alerts. I'll DM finance for final approval on the $5k credit.

samir: awesome. one more ask: can someone attach a short note in the thread with how to revoke access if POC ends early? we should include revoke steps in the email to them.

natalie: revoke steps (to include in email):
1) remove acme-poc group from vault secret access
2) rwctl billing projects archive --id poc-acme-8821
3) delete Dedicated pool or set min=0 and remove service account keys
4) confirm via ticket closure to emma@acme.com

keith: tagging security: @security if they start the questionnaire please prioritize network/peering checklist.

samir: Thanks all — I'll draft the kickoff email to emma with links to the API key retrieval, POC runbook, and the security questionnaire. Target: send Fri morning after finance OK. :rocket:
